checked: Only the exact fixed full designs or exact separate-namespace validation designs are accepted, including cell order and all physical cells.
Full exploratory entry requests committed-dependency capture before output creation or source work; code review confirms composition with the previously reviewed actual recorded-Git-byte verifier.
Pure preflight and raw-complete resume do not alter bytes, append histories or generate sources; closed audited/completed states reject raw resume.
A complete, clean postprocessing-review state returns cached metadata while retaining its original error fields; incomplete review states cannot claim cached completion.
Interrupted execution resumes only remaining source addresses; a complete cell ahead of the root map is adopted through the cached cell return without regeneration.
Exact canonical design bytes, provenance identity and dependency membership, environment, numerical procedure, completed-cell counts and root/cell layouts are verified before mutation.

Every committed and orphan partition is scanned for explicit string pipeline-error evidence, including cells absent from a lagging root map. Nonempty, missing and malformed error fields block automatic replay.
Ordinary invalid point candidates with an empty pipeline-error field remain retained statistical outcomes rather than becoming implementation errors or triggering resampling.
Orphan adoption requires exact byte equality and preserves its original replication range even when the requested partition size changes. Byte-different orphans are not overwritten.
Fresh pipeline failures retain all planned rows and explicit error counts, then block automatic retry.
A synthetic spawn-worker failure preserves the completed cell and honest incomplete status; resumption completes only unfinished work.
Nonblocking root-lock exclusion, archive-ancestor protection, symbolic-link rejection and observed-workspace-sync containment prevent unintended output mutation.
Injected external root drift preserves observed bytes and an adjacent incident record; cached exception handling does not overwrite the changed root, and the incident blocks later automatic resume.

A partial set of regular PNG/PDF files without a figure manifest can survive a cached postprocessing resume without any figure-completion claim. Unknown extensions and symbolic links still reject. A present figure manifest retains exact file-set/hash verification.

independent_test_execution.fixture_boundary: Actual orchestrator, historical _execute_cell and CellStore; only historical source_records replaced by deterministic literal records. Worker-exception test uses synthetic Future objects and verifies the requested spawn context.

limitations: The engineering tests generate no OU observations; native worker/partition equivalence and source/fit records are validated by the separate mathematical execution review and its eight native reference cases.
Raw completion remains pending reporting, independent artifact audit, figures, actual visual review and scientific publication.
Advisory locks and before/after byte guards do not provide atomic exclusion against every noncooperating external writer.
Fault injections and isolated-output containment do not identify or claim to repair the cause of the historical runtime incidents.
The partial-figure allowance does not certify file names, content correctness or figure completion; those require the later plotting and audit stages.

review_refinements.issue: The known epsilon-table-manifest filename was absent from the raw root-layout allowlist.
review_refinements.resolution: epsilon_table_manifest.json is explicitly allowed for later postprocessing; its substantive validation remains with the reporting/audit stages.

review_refinements.issue: A plotting interruption can leave PNG/PDF files before figure_manifest.json, so requiring that manifest for every nonempty figure directory blocked legitimate cached postprocessing recovery.
review_refinements.resolution: Only ordinary PNG/PDF files are permitted without a manifest; saved bytes and review-required status are preserved. Two focused lifecycle regressions verify the narrow exception and rejection boundaries.
